items.name: schema-engine-form-utils
items.title: Form utils
items.description: className helper for Schema Engine form elements.

items.name: schema-engine-form-field-primitive
items.title: Schema Engine field
items.description: Label, description, and error chrome for Schema Engine fields.
items.docs: Import controls.css once in your global stylesheet, unlayered and after Tailwind and the recipe styles: @import "./components/ui/schema-engine/components/controls.css"; (adjust the path to your ui alias). It lets the size appearance axis set the height of the form controls that carry data-se-control and the font size of a field.

items.name: schema-form
items.title: Schema Engine forms (Base UI)
items.description: All Base UI Schema Engine form elements and the generated registration barrel.
items.docs: Import schemaFormRegistrations from @/components/schema-engine/forms/registrations and pass them to createFormEngine({ elements: [...] }).

items.name: schema-engine-form-recipes
items.title: Schema Engine default recipes (Base UI)
items.description: Default Base UI view recipes and the generated recipe registration barrel.
items.docs: Import schemaFormRecipeRegistrations from @/components/schema-engine/forms/recipes/registrations and pass them to createFormEngine({ recipes: [...] }). Import the recipe styles once in your global stylesheet: @import "./components/schema-engine/forms/recipes/recipes.css" layer(components); (the path is relative to that stylesheet: ../components/... from a Next.js app/globals.css).
